items.title: Professor Longhair (Henry Roeland Byrd) Interview, 1978-Fall Transcript
items.q: my favorite artists in the blues line was Rocky Sullivan, Stormy Weather, Bertrand, Toots.

ctx.x: Uh, you have a style that's very original to me because it combines, without going to the musical technicalities of it, uh, style elements of marches, a lot of Spanish influences, Caribbean influences, rumbas, boogie woogie. Uh, where does some of that come from? And like, who'd you listen to like when you were growing up?

Well, anything that sounded good to me, whatever attracted me is when I got involved in. And, uh, I listened to, uh, blues, real top blues musicians. I've listened to real top jazz musicians. And I've listened to top Spanish musicians. And sometimes I was involved with them, you know? And so, uh, I practiced these things. Whatever I liked is this, I just started practicing them. And I made a gumbo out of them. I put whatever I wanted together with whatever I needed to support me in my own ideas and what I was…
